entities.summary: Edith Frances Mulhall Achilles, was an American psychologist known for her contributions to school and clinical psychology, particularly in the areas of memory development and recognition in children. Her experimental work on recall and recognition helped contribute to psychological assessment practices for immigrant children in the early 20th century. Her career included academic, clinical, and organizational contributions to psychology both in the United States and abroad.
